programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Killing of Tristyn Bailey 13-year-old Tristyn Bailey is stabbed 114 times by a classmate. Her murder shocks the world as the case goes viral on TikTok.
programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral

programme.desc: S07 E08 — Secrets in a Small Town Burlington, N.C., is a town built on family, God, and Southern hospitality, but it's shaken to its core when a local Sunday school teacher is brutally murdered.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S07 E06 — The Reporter Beautiful, ambitious reporter Jennifer Servo is shockingly murdered in 2002; Kelly and Steve are determined to help the Abilene Police Department catch her killer.
programme.title: Cold Justice

programme.desc: S02 E13 — Bigfoot Revealed For 54 years, the famed Patterson-Gimlin Bigfoot film has been touted as the best proof the creature exists; with AI technology, a never-before-seen restoration of the film makes the figure known as "Patty" clearer than ever before.
programme.title: The Proof Is Out There

programme.desc: A Ghost Witch Attacks & More The spirit of a witch attacks a team of paranormal investigators; a legendary cryptid is on the hunt for children; a poltergeist smashes counters at a vape shop.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hairdresser Fury (The Joleen Cummings story) Examining the evil acts that Jennifer Sybert, a hairdresser in Florida, tried to keep hidden from her colleague, top stylist Joleen Cummings; an entanglement with Joleen's ex blows the lid off Jennifer's criminal past, and leads to a ghastly slaying.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Charleston Buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy are summoned; the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern is uncovered; a spirit stalking one of the investigators is confronted.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Mummies Rethink what it's known about death and preservation; see why Denmark's perfectly preserved Tollund Man raises questions, observe Portuguese bodies that rewrite history, and uncover the mystery of Scotland's Frankenstein mummies.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Fog of War Hunt for the Amber Room, a Nazi-looted treasure that disappeared in 1944; track the final flight of bandleader Glenn Miller over the English Channel, then re-examine the arrest of Anne Frank to see if she was betrayed or a victim of coincidence.
programme.title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Stone Cold Mysteries Get petrified by cryptic rock structures normally hidden from view; look inside curious dwellings in the Peruvian Andes; visit a sacred monolith in Wyoming's Black Hills; haunt a Turkish stone village; spot an immovable waterfall in Mexico.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: Is Elvis Really Dead? Elvis' music will live on forever.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: JFK Prediction Experts investigate if a mysterious caller had inside knowledge about the assassination of President John F. Kennedy.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Spirit Protectors The difficulty of knowing whether a spirit is an evil entity or a protective ghost.
